LOI_instrument: FTT oxygen index apparatus, Fire Testing Technology, E Grinstead, UK

LOI_locator: Table 1 LOI column; section 3.2 selection of 1:9:7 for further analysis.

source_location: Original publisher sections 2.1–2.4; Table 1; section 3.2 selection paragraph and TGA-MS prose; Figure 6 caption; section 4.
limitations: Final TG residues have no explicitly attached assessment temperature in the numerical prose; residue temperature remains blank, separately from the 600 °C ramp endpoint. Approximate degradation events and MCC peak temperatures are not canonical TG temperatures. Table 1 char residues concern vertical flame testing and are not TGA. The general characterization statement specifies triplicate measurements, but the ± statistic is undefined. LOI specimen dimensions and conditioning are not stated; VFT and tensile dimensions are not transferred. Rinsing belongs to preparation; durability laundering was not studied. Other four formulation LOIs lack matching exact TG observations. The prose calls 27.0 the highest LOI although Table 1 has 27.1 for 1:7:7; these are different formulations and the proposed 1:9:7 value agrees in table, prose and conclusion.
source_numeric_evidence_description: LOI from Table 1; exact generic TG residues from original Figure 6-associated prose; air from the Figure 6 caption.
washing_state: Uncoated reference; no durability laundering reported
treatment_method: Commercial TestFabrics spun PA6,6 plain-weave reference. The deposition method describes a DI-water rinse and 70 °C drying before coating; whether the uncoated reference underwent that preparatory rinse is not separately stated.
pairing_evidence: Table 1 uncoated PA6,6 LOI 23.5 and section 3.2 uncoated TGA residue 3.4 explicitly use the same textile reference. No powder, resin or separately formulated control is substituted.

Immerse 5 min at liquor ratio 1:20, dry 70 °C, immerse in GP solution at pH 4 for 5 min, dry, DI-water rinse and dry again. Final drying time is not stated. Table S1 source recipe for three VFT samples lists 150 g of 1.8% CS solution, 150 g of 15.9% TA solution and 300 g of 6.2% GP solution.
pairing_evidence: Table 1 exact 1:9:7 LOI 27.0 is selected explicitly for further analysis in section 3.2; ensuing coated PA6,6 TGA-MS prose gives 22.4 wt% residue. Common two-step preparation and initial state link both assays; no other formulation receives this TG value.
